<TEI xmlns='http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0'><seg xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" type="excerpt" xml:id="ex107012023-10-06-110204" ana="corpusmd:colophon" status="unreviewed"> <milestone unit="section" n="Colophon"/>
            shing rta chen po <rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:named_reference">dpal mar me mdzad ye shes</rs> kyi thugs kyi bcud phyung ba <rs type="work" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:5421">byang chub <pb n="203b"/><lb n="203b1"/> lam gyi sgron ma'i rnam par bshad pa phul byung dgongs pa'i rgyan</rs> zhes bya ba 'di ni | <rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:named_reference">jo bo chen po</rs> <rs type="place">bod yul</rs> du phyags phab nas <hi rendition="#Time">lo bzhi brgya dang nga brgyad</hi> 'das pa na| <rs type="person" ana="">bla ma dam pa rnams</rs> kyi bka' drin gyis 'tsho ba <rs type="person" ana="">dge slong kun mtshan</rs> gyis <lb n="203b2"/> <rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:4593">dge ba'i bshes gnyen</rs> gong ma dag gi gsung la gces spras su dang nan tan du byas te rang bzo dang bral bar | dpal <rs type="place" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:5765">rtses thang gi chos gra chen po</rs>r legs par bsdebs pa'o ||
               'dis kyang rgyal ba'i bstan pa rin po che dar zhing rgyas la yun ring du <lb n="203b3"/> gnas par byed nus par gyur cig | drag po zhes bya lcags spre'u  dbyar 'bring gi || rgyal bas chos 'khor skor ba'i dus chen la || shing  rta'i lam <rs type="work" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:5421">chen byang chub lam sgron gyi || rnam bshad phul byung dgongs pa'i rgyan</rs> 'di grub||  ||</seg></TEI>
